_comment: DRAFT (dialogue-drafts lane 2026-07-06, NOT wired). 'The Bridge Toll' — the game's first joke quest; voice-lint hard per spec. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-06-home-region-content-2-design.md §2/§4. Voice contract: character-profiles-staging.md 'The toll-goblin' (broken-Common with dignity, price-anchoring bits, total sincerity once hired). Speaker 'Toll' = self-named goblin (canon-resonant: goblins earn/take their own names) — ORIGINAL+flag. The [Diplomat] class gate on the hire chain is an in-fiction exception per the goblin_parley precedent. Wiring + opens: toll_goblin.md.
_hired_talk_pool_note: Draft of the hired-lookout rotating pool — belongs in skeleton_scene.json entity data as talk_pool_post {requires_accomplishment:{hired_toll_goblin:1}}, per Lyonette's C4 pool-growth precedent. NOT part of the graph.
_hired_talk_pool: Wagon at dawn. Ox angry, man angrier, cabbages. Paid no toll — wagon too fast. Remembered forever.
Big deer on north field. Antlers ORANGE. Not on fire. Checked twice.
Boulder by east rocks MOVED. Boulders not move. This one moves. Watching it. Not blinking much.
More goblins on gate road. Not my goblins. My goblins is me.

hub.speaker: Toll
hub.text: Bridge MINE. Toll two gold. Is official. Sash says.

text_variants.text: You. Hitting one. ...Toll one gold. Special price. No hitting.
Boss! Bridge safe, road talky. Toll one gold — boss discount is zero. Toll is PRINCIPLE.

options.text: A goblin who can hold a bridge could hold something better. (Persuade)
What did the road say today?

paid.speaker: Toll
paid.text: Good traveler. BEST traveler. Bridge very safe now. Toll covers both ways. Today only. Is promotion.

haggle.speaker: Toll
haggle.text: Planks GOOD planks. Counted twice. ...Fine. One gold. One gold and shiny rock. Deal-deal.

options.text: (Pay 1 gold. Hand over a river pebble.)

paid_haggle.speaker: Toll
paid_haggle.text: Hm. Shiny-ish. ...Deal stands. Toll paid. Rock goes in rock pile. Is BIG pile. Go, go.

standoff.speaker: Toll
standoff.text: Rude! Bridge law says— says NO. Sash outranks you. Toll or teeth.

hire_pitch.speaker: Toll
hire_pitch.text: ...Better how. Bridge is mine. Mine is GOOD. Had worse. Had nothing. Nothing is worse.

options.text: Keep the bridge. Watch the road. I pay for what you see — that makes you a lookout, and a lookout outranks a toll-goblin.

hire_deal.speaker: Toll
hire_deal.text: Look-out. LOOK-out. ...Outranks sash? Hm. Hm hm hm. Toll stays. Small toll. Lookout with toll. Both jobs. Double official.

options.text: Done. The toll stays — and the road's news comes to me first.
That's not how ranks work. Forget it.

hired.speaker: Toll
hired.text: DEAL. You boss now. Toll watches EVERYTHING. Wagons, deer, rocks, sneaky rocks. Report is free. Toll is not free. Toll is never free.

gossip_nudge.speaker: Toll
gossip_nudge.text: Road talks all day. Toll listens all day. Ask again when Toll is standing at post — post is THERE. Two steps. Professional distance.
